description: Statewide snowpack from every active SNOTEL station in one state: snow water equivalent as a percent of the 30-year median (summed over stations), the median station percent, how many stations report and have snow, the deepest site, and every station with its snow depth, SWE and percent of median, sorted by depth, SWE, percent of median, elevation or name.

state.description: State code or name: AK, AZ, CA, CO, ID, MT, NV, NM, OR, SD, UT, WA or WY.

top.description: How many stations to name in the summary. Default 10; the structured list has every station.

name: snowpack_by_state
title: Snowpack by state
